description: Sri Lanka Customs - Notify the Rates of Exchange effective from 20.08.2018 to 26.02.2018
reasoning: This gazette notification is issued under the Customs Ordinance (Chapter 235) and concerns the determination of official exchange rates for customs duties and charges. It constitutes a regulatory framework for customs operations, falls under statutory instruments/subsidiary legislation, and rescinds a previous notification - all characteristics of Legal/Regulatory matters.
